note: OFAC lists are point-in-time snapshots (publish 2026-08-07), not historical series. They give current sanction state per entity; the 2012-2022 window is served by matching entities whose sanctions are active in-window. GSDB provides the long-run country-pair history for the window.

ofac_sdn.window_coverage: snapshot only; per-entry start dates not in file. If in-window historical state needed, pull delta archive (GetDeltaFileArchive) and reconstruct
ofac_sdn.gaps: no startDate field in current XML schema

gsdb.gaps: blocked on email request to gsdb@drexel.edu / website form; no public mirror found 2026-08-09
